Title: Stand-in Tier+Tactical AddAmmo Event
Author: Blockland ReImagined tests
Written for tests. It has the community Event_AddAmmoTT folder name and the
shape its port reads (the AddAmmoTT output for players and bots, and
Player::addAmmoTT handing out the ammo types), so the listed port applies to
it. It is not the original Add-On and holds none of its files.
